context.note: NativeBackend seam is explicitly designed for additive platform backends. Comments in native_backend.dart state: 'a later `UiAutomator2Backend` is purely additive'
Platform field already exists in NativeSnapshot and accepts 'ios'|'android' per the type comment. Host CLI already wires --platform flag (defaults to 'ios').

Android-specific divergences are already anticipated in comments: iOS ASWebAuthenticationSession consent vs no system alert on Android; iOS Done vs Android back keyboard dismiss; iOS attribute/value vs Android attribute/text readback. These are scoped as 'inside the impl, never in extension/tools'.

The m5 spec (Auth0 e2e, iOS-proven milestone) notes Android as explicitly out-of-scope but mentions 'the adaptive-consent path from lenny-qxx.5 should already tolerate its absence' for Android (where no system consent alert appears).
The m2 spec explicitly defers Android as 'purely additive later'. Per-platform branching is kept behind the NativeBackend seam interface.

Chrome Custom Tab is noted in the bead description as the Auth0 Android flow (distinct from iOS ASWebAuthenticationSession), but the bead's acceptance criteria focus on UiAutomator2 backend impl + unit tests + live Android e2e, not Auth0-specific adaptive handling.

Ratified standards: ADR-0001 (Perception framework, Accepted design), ADR-0002 (Perception migration, Accepted strategy), ADR-0003 (Model backend on dartantic, Accepted decision, 2026-06-16). All are about perception/model layers, not platform backends. No ratified ADR constrains backend seam design or platform selection.

ADR-0000 contains two pending amendments (A1 on registration contract, A2 on community overlap). A1 affects 'leonard_contract registry' — this bead does not change the extension contract. A2 recommends 'adopt Dart-team plumbing' — this bead implements a platform backend, not transport/plumbing.

Naming convention per umbrella CLAUDE.md: 'Package names are human faculties/crafts/achievements, never agent-nouns' (e.g., 'typesetting', not 'etcher'). 'UiAutomator2Backend' is a backend (noun describing the service, not an agent-noun), consistent with 'AppiumBackend'. The `leonard_*` package prefix is used correctly.
The host file bin/leonard_native_host.dart currently always instantiates AppiumBackend, regardless of platform flag. The bead must wire --platform android to select UiAutomator2Backend instead.
No ADR or ratified standard governs the specific W3C WebDriver endpoints or XML parsing strategy for UiAutomator2 vs XCUITest. This is a pure implementation detail within the backend seam.
